label: For an arbitrary selected perfection and supplied preorder of represented…, from MAXIMAL_5 principle
meaning: In a calibration frame, a greatest-degree bearer is maximal: anything more such than it would have the perfection and, by calibration among bearers, a strictly higher degree than the greatest, which is impossible. The stronger analyst maximal-in-genus principle (OPEN) then makes it the cause of all others. Shows that the stronger analyst configuration entails the greatest-degree source reading under calibration and more-such-has; not a derivation of the source reading from weaker premises.
